asset.name: MessageList
asset.description: The message collection preserving streaming scroll position, supporting branching, grouping, history loading, a new-message indicator, and stable anchoring while content grows above and below.

requires.reason: Windowing and focus preservation are shared.
Loading, empty, partial, stale, error, and offline presentation are delegated rather than reimplemented.

signatureMoment.description: New content streaming in never moves what the reader is currently looking at, and a single clear control returns them to the live edge when they choose to go back.

rationale: Scroll anchoring during streaming is the defining hard problem: content grows continuously at the bottom while history loads at the top, and almost every naive implementation either yanks the reader to the end or strands them mid-message.
